comment: Political support and a willing implementation community are used as selection criteria. This may deprioritise the needs of marginalised populations that lack political influence or organised institutional support.

anchor.note: p.89 l.Lines 48-53 read as the printed page; section 4.1.2 agrees

public.text: Political support and a willing implementation community are used as selection criteria. This may deprioritise the needs of marginalised populations that lack political influence or organised institutional support.
public.suggestedRevision: Add disease burden, service inequity, affected population, public value, unmet need, feasibility, risk, and potential to strengthen shared infrastructure as selection criteria.
